home.founderH2: We built the CRM we always wished existed.
home.founderP1: After years watching service businesses lose leads to slow replies, missed follow-ups, and disconnected tools we decided to build something different.
home.founderP2: LeadOS is not a CRM that stores data and hopes you will use it. It is an operating system that actively works to turn every lead into revenue 24 hours a day without adding headcount.
home.founderP3: Every feature we build answers one question: does this help a service business convert more leads into bookings? If not, we do not build it.
home.finalSub: Join service businesses using LeadOS to capture every lead, book more appointments, and grow without adding headcount.
